clue.text: A Blue's switched in running order

indicators.note: switched means the letters of these words are swapped about into a new order

parts.note: the possessive 's counts here as a letter S added to the word blue

explanation.surface: A member of the Blues team has had his place changed in the running order.
explanation.definitionFit: Something usable is serviceable, ready to work, just as a machine in running order is.

clue.text: Move about a step

indicators.note: about means one word goes round the other here

parts.note: to stir is to move

explanation.surface: An instruction to shift something a step.
explanation.definitionFit: A single tread of a staircase is a step.

clue.text: Complain after excellent food

indicators.note: after puts the complaining word behind the word for excellent

parts.note: bully is old slang for excellent, as in 'bully for you'
to beef is slang for to complain

explanation.surface: Someone grumbling after a very good meal.
explanation.walkthrough: BULLY BEEF is tinned corned beef, a British army ration.
explanation.definitionFit: Corned beef in tins is a kind of preserved meat.

clue.text: I clear out some of the pastrycook's stock

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of the words are put out of their order

explanation.surface: A baker's shop announcing it is clearing its stock.
explanation.definitionFit: A cream-filled choux finger is one of the cakes a pastrycook sells.

clue.text: Have a girlfriend, but don't rush things

explanation.surface: Advice to someone with a new girlfriend to take it slowly.
explanation.definitionFit: To date one partner regularly is one sense; the other is the plea to slow down and take care.

clue.text: Want a proverb to be self-evident

parts.note: to want something is to lack it, to go without
a proverb is a saying

explanation.surface: Wishing a proverb to be obviously true.
explanation.definitionFit: Something too obvious to need stating is plainly evident.

clue.text: Take girl to party for a dance

parts.note: Sara is a girl's name
a band is a party or group of people

explanation.surface: Taking a girl to a party to dance.
explanation.definitionFit: The saraband is a stately Spanish court dance in slow triple time.

clue.text: Some of the letters temp types are unsatisfactory

indicators.note: some of the letters means the word sits inside the run of letters that follows

explanation.surface: A complaint that a temporary typist's letters are not good enough.
explanation.definitionFit: Something hollow or without substance leaves one unsatisfied.

clue.text: Atone for being a fool and a milksop

parts.note: a dope is a fool
nance is a dated slang word for an effeminate or feeble man, a milksop

explanation.surface: Making amends for being foolish and weak.
explanation.definitionFit: To make amends for a sin is to perform acts of penitence.

clue.text: Fats about to become runny in plant

indicators.note: about means the jazz pianist's name goes round the other piece

parts.note: Fats Waller was a famous American jazz pianist
to flow is to become runny

explanation.surface: Melting fats in a plant pot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fats' looks like grease; it is Fats Waller.
explanation.definitionFit: The wallflower is a sweet-scented garden plant.

clue.text: 15 or 105 gallons

definitions.meaning: points to 15 across, a flourish or decoration, as piping on a cake or a uniform
a large wine cask holding about 105 gallons

explanation.definitionFit: Piping is a decorative trim, and a large wine cask of that measure has the same name.

clue.text: From this I find military's dispositions

definitions.text: From this I find military's dispositions

indicators.note: dispositions means the letters of the military word are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: Reading off the deployment of troops from a reference list.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer plus I rearranges to MILITARYS, and the published list does show where officers are posted.
explanation.definitionFit: The official register of army officers shows their postings, hence the forces' dispositions.

clue.text: Past that, having retired

indicators.note: having means the place of retirement holds the other word

parts.note: someone who has retired for the night is in bed
yon is an old word for that

explanation.surface: Someone well past it after retiring.
explanation.definitionFit: Further on than something, or past it, is the sense here.

clue.text: Forced to be a servant, by the sound of it

indicators.note: by the sound of it means a word is said aloud and heard as another

parts.note: a maid is a female servant

explanation.surface: A complaint about being forced into service.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone compelled to do something was obliged to.

clue.text: Love a party, taking one's share

parts.note: a do is a party
a ration is a share

explanation.surface: Someone who loves a party and wants a share of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep devotion or worship is a form of love.

clue.text: Tenor — man somehow providing a flourish

indicators.note: somehow means the letters of the words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A singer adds a decorative trill to a phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A decorative flourish in music or writing is an embellishment.

clue.text: Clever plan to give chap work overseas

parts.note: a chap is a man
oeuvre is the French for a work, so a foreign word

explanation.surface: A scheme to find a man a job abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: A cunning scheme or stratagem is a clever move.

clue.text: Stop purchase forcibly

parts.note: a purchase is a grip or hold
hard means with force

explanation.surface: Halting a sale by force.
explanation.definitionFit: An old command to halt, originally to a horse, meaning wait.

clue.text: Beard producing criminal appearance

parts.note: a con is a convict, a criminal
a front is an outward appearance

explanation.surface: A bearded man who looks like a crook.
explanation.definitionFit: To beard someone is to face them boldly.

clue.text: Born and died in want

parts.note: née means born, used before a maiden name

explanation.surface: Someone born and dying in poverty.
explanation.definitionFit: Want is lack or necessity.

clue.text: Timid fellow captured in a foray

indicators.note: captured in means one piece is held inside the other

parts.note: a foray is a raid

explanation.surface: A fearful man taken prisoner during a raid.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone timid is fearful.

clue.text: Lay about everybody — sorry!

indicators.note: about means one word wraps round the other

parts.note: bad, as in sorry or poor
all means everybody

explanation.surface: An apology for loafing around in front of everybody.
explanation.definitionFit: A lay is a song or narrative poem.

clue.text: Flexible man fired first

indicators.note: first means the word for fired comes before the man

parts.note: lit means set on fire
he is a man

explanation.surface: An agile man was the first to shoot.
explanation.definitionFit: Lithe means supple and bending easily.

clue.text: A little money once missing from the King's business — it's out in the open

indicators.note: missing from means a coin is taken out of the business

parts.note: King Alfred's company: Alfred the Great, ninth-century King of Wessex
d was the abbreviation for a penny in pre-decimal British money

explanation.surface: A shortfall in a king's accounts is out in the open.
explanation.walkthrough: Old British coins: d stood for a penny before 1971.
explanation.definitionFit: Done in the fresh air, outdoors.

clue.text: Enchanting woman left out of the group

indicators.note: out of means a letter is removed from the group

parts.note: a circle is a group of people

explanation.surface: A charming woman excluded from a social set.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek sorceress who turned Odysseus's men into swine.

clue.text: County has more than one flag like this

definitions.text: County has more than one flag like this

parts.words: County has more than one flag like this
parts.note: the abbreviation of ..., an English county, reads as the plural of a verb meaning to droop or flag

explanation.surface: A county flies several flags.
explanation.definitionFit: To flag is to droop or lose energy.

clue.text: Pass critical comment when I am featured in a commercial

indicators.note: featured in means the contraction is set inside the advertisement

parts.note: a commercial is an advert
I am contracts to I'm

explanation.surface: Someone criticising an advertisement they appear in.
explanation.definitionFit: To criticise or censure.

clue.text: Loser might be grounded

parts.note: a dog lying beneath on the ground, punning on the expected loser

explanation.definitionFit: The expected loser in a contest.

clue.text: Stamps used by the Spanish or German engineer

parts.note: dies are stamps for striking coins
el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: Stamps used in Spain or Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: Rudolf Diesel invented the compression-ignition engine.
